newsitem.title: USA: Network Event says sells 10.3 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Network Event says sells 10.3 pct stake.

text.p: Network Event Theater Inc said Thursday Warburg Pincus Counsellors Inc paid $4.0 million in a private placement that will give it 10.3 percent ownership of the company.
The company said the completed private placement was for 1,015,873 unregistered shares of common stock.
The shares were issued at a price of $3.94 per share, which was a 10 percent discount to the then-market price.
Network said the additional capital will help finance future potential acquisitions.
Network Event Theater is a media and marketing services company focusing on the 17-25 year old young adult market.
